comparable_cases.case_name: Frances Christine Keeling v The Hebe Haven Yacht Club Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: (a) grade 3 medical lateral ligament laxity; (b) 80% tear of the anterior cruciate ligament; and (c) minor incomplete tear of the lateral meniscus. She undertook an arthroscopy of the right knee, open repair of the mild substance of the medical collateral ligament followed by immobilization of the right knee in a hinged knee brace. On discharge from hospital, she used a walking frame with the brace for 12 weeks. She was assessed to have suffered 5% total impairment of the whole person after treatment.
